recommendations.proposed_title: Reconcile Madagascar 119 scoped districts and 22 regions with current OCHA COD-AB

bounded_scope.source_version: OCHA COD-AB Madagascar v01, reviewed 2026-07-06, valid_on 2018-08-10
bounded_scope.source_units: All 120 ADM2 districts and all 24 ADM1 regions
bounded_scope.current_subjects: All 119 pinned Madagascar district IDs and all 22 current Madagascar province IDs in issue #482; include no other country/region
parent_crosswalk_questions: COD-AB Vatovavy and Fitovinany versus current Vatovavy-Fitovinany
COD-AB Haute Matsiatra versus current Matsiatra Ambony
COD-AB Ambatosoa spatially overlaps current Analanjirofo but has no normalized name match
Reconcile 15 name-matched COD-AB ADM2 overlays above the 5% screen and retained predecessor source versions

required_evidence: Restore original OCHA/BNGRC and predecessor administrative source notes, legal change instruments or current official boundary gazetteer, and licenses.
Exact code/name/date crosswalk for every 120 ADM2 and 24 ADM1 feature; explain new, split, renamed, removed and unchanged units.
Reproduce equal-area source/current geometry overlays for all matched units and parent descendant unions; inspect boundary slivers and neighbor consistency.
Engineering-owned integration proposal only after source authority and identity are resolved; no unilateral edits by geography research.

Reconcile 55 disconnected source components over 0.01 km² (64.588 km² total) across 10 assigned districts; they have <1% overlap current union and no GSHHG L1 intersections, which is inconclusive. Preserve component indexes/centroids and obtain official coastline/island history.
recommendations.reason: The current scope does not contain Antanimora Atsimo as an independent subject and its 22 parent regions do not directly map to all 24 COD-AB ADM1 source names. The source review is strong enough to require bounded reconciliation but not to prescribe an automatic split, merge or boundary change.

recommendations.proposed_title: Obtain current official Seychelles region-to-island and outer-island inventory

bounded_scope.full_packet_context: All 8 Seychelles source region locations and their 27 NBS-provenance ADM3 district rows

required_evidence: Current dated Seychelles NBS region/district/island crosswalk and official island inventory with source licenses.
Resolve four parent-label mismatches and trace Other Islands source 1,057 parts versus current 7 parts to named island/rock identities.
Use scale-appropriate official physical coast/island evidence; do not use census population or GSHHG non-detection as island absence proof.

Crosswalk every Mauritius Island district to 2022 municipal ward/Village Council Area records and Rodrigues local regions/locality lists; search for current official geocoded settlement sources for all 12 assigned Mauritius ADM1 subjects and 8 Seychelles regions, recording any source-access failure and leaving unavailable coverage unresolved.
recommendations.reason: The only retained statistical crosswalk is 2019/2010-derived; current labels and grouped outer-island completeness remain unresolved.

recommendations.proposed_title: Resolve official island/reef geometry for Mauritius outer islands and Agalega records

bounded_scope.context: Inspect all 12 Mauritius ADM1 source records because the producer defines a mixed district/outer-islands layer.

required_evidence: Current official island/reef inventory with dated source, scale, coordinate reference, license and named components.
Reconcile both spatially disjoint Agalega footprints against the 2022 census group and identify each included island/rock.
Determine what St Brandon source geometry represents; population count/no permanent residents is not physical geography.
Check other Mauritius/outer-island assigned members for completeness against the same official inventory.
recommendations.reason: GSHHG 2.3.7 level 1 does not intersect St Brandon or the Natural Earth Agalega footprint, but that coarse non-detection cannot establish absent reef or land.

recommendations.proposed_title: Find an authoritative Comoros settlement/locality gazetteer with geospatial coordinates

bounded_scope.physical_components: The three retained source island units: Anjouan, Grande Comore and Mohéli

required_evidence: Official dated gazetteer/census locality list tied to the three named islands and administrative hierarchy, with geometry or coordinates and reuse terms.
Compare every official locality to the HOTOSM/OSM screen while preserving its volunteer-mapping limitation.
Inspect outer islets and administrative remainders without inferring boundaries from political claims.
recommendations.reason: COD-AB supports a 3/17/55 admin hierarchy and COD-PS supports ADM1 statistics, but no authoritative complete settlement coordinate source was found; HOTOSM supplies only 565 volunteer-mapped features.

issue_creation_notes: Three source-restoration follow-up issues were created blocked and depend on completion of #482. They are not ready or claimable; readiness/overlap review remains required.
